f3_program: collection("keanu.purchased_fish", "fish", "keanu", source("some fish from the store for his pets"))
observe(at("keanu.fish_given_to_dog.count", "current"), 40, "count", source("he gave his dog 40 fish"))
fraction_of(at("keanu.fish_given_to_cat.count", "current"), at("keanu.fish_given_to_dog.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("He gave his cat half as many fish as he gave to his dog"))
sum_relation(at("keanu.purchased_fish.count", "current"), at("keanu.fish_given_to_dog.count", "current"), at("keanu.fish_given_to_cat.count", "current"), source("all the fish"))
observe(at("store.fish.unit_cost", "current"), 4, "dollar_per_fish", source("each fish cost him $4"))
product_relation("keanu.fish_purchase.total_cost", at("keanu.purchased_fish.count", "current"), at("store.fish.unit_cost", "current"), source("each fish cost him $4"))
query("value", "keanu.fish_purchase.total_cost")
collection("easter_eggs", "egg", "unspecified", source("the Easter eggs"))
fraction_of(at("easter_eggs.blue.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.count", "current"), 4, 5, source("4/5 of the Easter eggs are blue"))
fraction_of(at("easter_eggs.purple.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.count", "current"), 1, 5, source("1/5 are purple"))
collection("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces", "egg", "easter_eggs", source("Half the purple eggs have five pieces of candy each, and 1/4 of the blue eggs do"))
fraction_of(at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.purple.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.purple.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Half the purple eggs have five pieces of candy each"))
fraction_of(at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.blue.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.blue.count", "current"), 1, 4, source("1/4 of the blue eggs do"))

sum_relation(at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.purple.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.blue.count", "current"), source("Half the purple eggs have five pieces of candy each, and 1/4 of the blue eggs do"))
observe(at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.candy_per_egg", "current"), 5, "candy_piece_per_egg", source("five pieces of candy each"))
collection("easter_eggs.one_candy_piece", "egg", "easter_eggs", source("The rest of the eggs only have one piece of candy"))
observe(at("easter_eggs.one_candy_piece.candy_per_egg", "current"), 1, "candy_piece_per_egg", source("one piece of candy"))

sum_relation(at("easter_eggs.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.one_candy_piece.count", "current"), source("The rest of the eggs only have one piece of candy"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.count", "current"))
collection("weight_loss_group.people", "person", "weight_loss_group", source("Four people"))
observe(at("weight_loss_group.people.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("Four people"))
observe(at("weight_loss_group.total_weight_loss", "current"), 103, "kilogram", source("a total of 103 kilograms of weight"))
observe(at("weight_loss_group.people.first.weight_loss", "current"), 27, "kilogram", source("The first person lost 27 kilograms"))

offset(at("weight_loss_group.people.second.weight_loss", "current"), at("weight_loss_group.people.first.weight_loss", "current"), -7, "kilogram", source("The second person lost 7 kilograms less than the first person"))
same(at("weight_loss_group.people.third.weight_loss", "current"), at("weight_loss_group.people.fourth.weight_loss", "current"), source("The two remaining people lost the same amount"))

sum_relation(at("weight_loss_group.total_weight_loss", "current"), at("weight_loss_group.people.first.weight_loss", "current"), at("weight_loss_group.people.second.weight_loss", "current"), at("weight_loss_group.people.third.weight_loss", "current"), at("weight_loss_group.people.fourth.weight_loss", "current"), source("Four people lost a total of 103 kilograms of weight"))
query("value", at("weight_loss_group.people.third.weight_loss", "current"))
observe(at("jade.money", "initial"), 38, "currency", source("Jade had $38"))
fraction_of(at("julia.money", "initial"), at("jade.money", "initial"), 1, 2, source("her sister Julia had half as much money she had"))
add("aunt_gift_to_jade", "aunt", at("jade.money", "current"), "aunt.gift_to_jade.amount", source("their aunt gave each of them an equal amount of money"))
add("aunt_gift_to_julia", "aunt", at("julia.money", "current"), "aunt.gift_to_julia.amount", source("their aunt gave each of them an equal amount of money"))
same(event_field("aunt_gift_to_jade", "quantity"), event_field("aunt_gift_to_julia", "quantity"), source("each of them an equal amount of money"))
observe(at("sisters.money.total", "current"), 97, "currency", source("they had a total of $97"))

sum_relation(at("sisters.money.total", "current"), at("jade.money", "initial"), at("julia.money", "initial"), event_field("aunt_gift_to_jade", "quantity"), event_field("aunt_gift_to_julia", "quantity"), source("their aunt gave each of them an equal amount of money so that they had a total of $97"))
query("value", event_field("aunt_gift_to_jade", "quantity"))
